name: Contact Ajax
project_description: Contact Ajax adds AJAX submission to Drupal core's Contact forms. The 3.x major targets Drupal 11 and 12 (core_version_requirement ^11 || ^12) and requires only the core contact module. It works entirely through form alters and third-party settings on each contact form entity — no routes, services, permissions, or plugins of its own. When you edit a contact form at admin/structure/contact, a 'Contact ajax' fieldset lets you enable AJAX submission per form and choose what to load after a successful submit: the default status message, the default message plus an emptied form, the rendered content of a chosen node, or a custom formatted message. Advanced settings let you override the wrapper element id and render the AJAX response into a different HTML element than the form's own wrapper. Because submission still runs through the standard core contact form workflow, existing access control and flood limits continue to apply; only the page-reload is replaced by an AJAX response. Suggested companion modules: contact_storage (persist messages) and honeypot (spam protection).
